description: This file contains functions for sending messages, images, links, reactions, and events via the Zalouser messaging system, including text chunking and style handling.

methods.name: sendMessageZalouser
methods.description: Splits and sends a text message in chunks, handling styles and modes.

methods.name: sendImageZalouser
methods.description: Sends an image with optional caption.

methods.name: sendReactionZalouser
methods.description: Sends or removes a reaction emoji to a message.

methods.name: splitStyledText
methods.description: Splits styled text into chunks based on length and mode.

methods.name: sliceTextStyles
methods.description: Slices styles to fit within a text chunk.

methods.name: splitTextRanges
methods.description: Splits text into ranges based on length and mode.

methods.name: splitTextRangesByPreferredBreaks
methods.description: Splits text into ranges at paragraph or whitespace breaks.

methods.name: findParagraphBreak
methods.description: Finds paragraph break position in text.

methods.name: findLastBreak
methods.description: Finds last occurrence of a marker before a position.
